display.name: Bills & Receipts
display.description: Records a bill, receipt or credit note from a PDF or photo in QuickBooks Online: a bill as a bill, a receipt as an expense, a credit note as a vendor credit. Statements are compared, not recorded.

input.title: Document
input.description: A bill, receipt, credit note or statement: a PDF, or a JPEG or PNG photo.

input.title: I paid for this with my own money
input.description: Turn on when a team member or an owner paid for this personally, so it is recorded against the person who paid.

input.title: Who paid
input.description: Your name as QuickBooks shows it, or as this flow's Owners and partners setting writes it. Only with the switch above on.

requiredConnections.purpose: Looks up accounts, vendors, employees, bills and expenses, and creates vendors, bills, expenses, vendor credits and journal entries.

setup.title: Approval limit
setup.description: Records over this amount wait for an owner or admin to approve. 500 when left empty.

setup.title: Default category
setup.description: The QuickBooks category used when no category below applies, as QuickBooks shows it, without its number. For a sub-account: Parent:Child.

setup.title: Paid from
setup.description: The bank or credit card account the company pays receipts from, as QuickBooks shows it. Needed for receipts and card refunds.

setup.title: Company card's last four digits
setup.description: The last four digits of the company card. A receipt that shows another card waits for approval.

setup.title: Owed to team members
setup.description: A liability account, not Accounts Payable or a credit card, for what the company owes an employee who paid with their own money.

setup.title: Owner's investment account
setup.description: The equity account, such as Owner investments, for a purchase an owner or partner paid with their own money.

setup.title: Owners and partners
setup.description: One entry per person, separated by semicolons. Add = and an equity account for a person's own account, for example: Jane Doe = Partner investments:Jane; Sam Lee

setup.title: Category for meals
setup.description: The QuickBooks category for meals. The default category is used when this is left empty.

setup.title: Category for travel
setup.description: The QuickBooks category for travel. The default category is used when this is left empty.

setup.title: Category for vehicle and fuel
setup.description: The QuickBooks category for vehicle and fuel. The default category is used when this is left empty.

setup.title: Category for office supplies
setup.description: The QuickBooks category for office supplies. The default category is used when this is left empty.

setup.title: Category for software and subscriptions
setup.description: The QuickBooks category for software and subscriptions. The default category is used when this is left empty.

setup.title: Category for utilities and phone
setup.description: The QuickBooks category for utilities and phone. The default category is used when this is left empty.

setup.title: Category for rent
setup.description: The QuickBooks category for rent. The default category is used when this is left empty.

setup.title: Category for repairs and maintenance
setup.description: The QuickBooks category for repairs and maintenance. The default category is used when this is left empty.

setup.title: Category for professional services
setup.description: The QuickBooks category for professional services. The default category is used when this is left empty.

setup.title: Category for materials
setup.description: The QuickBooks category for materials. The default category is used when this is left empty.

setup.title: Category for advertising
setup.description: The QuickBooks category for advertising. The default category is used when this is left empty.

setup.title: Also email
setup.description: An address outside your workspace, such as your bookkeeper, that gets a short summary of each record.

pipeline.title: Document received
pipeline.description: A person starts the run with a PDF or photo of the document. The file is checked before anything is spent.

pipeline.title: Check the QuickBooks company
pipeline.description: Confirms QuickBooks is connected and the company is a US company, and whether it runs QuickBooks Payroll.

pipeline.title: Read QuickBooks settings
pipeline.description: Reads the home currency, the multicurrency setting, the closing date of the books and how vendor credits are numbered.

pipeline.title: Find the accounts in this flow's settings
pipeline.description: Finds every account this flow's settings name, in one lookup, and checks each is the right kind.

pipeline.title: Find who paid
pipeline.description: When someone paid with their own money: finds them among this flow's owners and partners, or as an employee in QuickBooks.

pipeline.title: Read the document
pipeline.description: The AI reads the document: its type, the seller, its number, dates, amounts and lines.
